chunks: "Whoever applies perfume at the beginning of the day while he is fasting will not lose his mind."

key_terms.تَطَيَّبَ: applied perfume or made oneself fragrant

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about wearing perfume while fasting?
ai.summary: This hadith states that applying perfume at the beginning of the day while fasting carries a beneficial effect. It reflects an aspect of conduct and bodily refinement that is compatible with the state of fasting.
